name: get_current_location
description: Get the current location of the user.

name: get_current_date
description: Get the current local date and timezone for resolving relative travel dates.

name: resolve_city_transport_nodes
description: Find local airport transport nodes for a city from the local IATA database.

city.description: City name, for example London or Paris.

name: search_flights
description: Search local demo flight candidates between two cities on a concrete travel date.

travel_date.description: Concrete ISO travel date, for example 2026-05-30.

max_results.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

name: plan_trip_transport
description: Build compact round-trip transport options using concrete ISO dates chosen by the LLM.

outbound_date.description: Concrete ISO outbound date chosen by the LLM, for example 2026-05-30.

return_date.description: Concrete ISO return date chosen by the LLM, for example 2026-05-31.

origin_city.description: Optional origin city. If omitted, the user's current location is used.

max_options.description: Maximum number of round-trip transport options to return.
